assignment_text.description: The writing assignment / prompt given to the student.

source_passages.description: Source passages in the order the student received them. Position is the source number: the first item is Source 1, the second is Source 2, and so on. The SDK does not sort or renumber this list. When a passage has no title or author, that number is a valid way for the student to name it.

essay_text.description: The student's essay, verbatim (may contain spelling/grammar errors).
